name: Coillnamham Fort
text: Coillnamham Fort is a name for Dún Aonghusa in the Aran Isles. The name compares with Irish coill, wood or forest, and namae, enemy. Liam O'Flaherty, the Anglo-Irish writer who lived from 1896 to 1984, uses this name. Other Anglo-Irish writers use it as well.

attributes.value: an alternate name for Dún Aonghusa
name used by Liam O'Flaherty and other Anglo-Irish writers

okr.objective: Coillnamham Fort is Liam O'Flaherty's name for the fort of Dún Aonghusa.
key_results: Coillnamham Fort (compare Irish coill, wood or forest, and namae, enemy) is a name for Dún Aonghusa in the Aran Isles.
